verdicts.reason: `notes={}` is a mutable default evaluated once at definition time, and the body mutates it (`notes[item.name] = "added"`) and returns it. Every call without an explicit `notes` argument shares and accumulates entries in the same dict, leaking state between users' wishlists — exactly the shared-default bug from the cart fix. The identical fix applies: `notes=None` plus `if notes is None: notes = {}`. Nothing guards against this elsewhere, and this is production code, not a test exercising the pattern.
